prompt: Notifications are flooding in from a repository the developer no longer cares about. What stops them at the source?
explanation: Notification volume is controlled per repository: unwatch stops the subscription, and ignore silences even @mentions from it. Global notification settings then shape how arriving notifications reach you.

options.text: Unwatch the repository (or set it to ignore)
Delete the account and start again
Close every issue in the repository
Turn off email everywhere and check the site hourly
